title: Launch HN: Coasty (YC S26) – An API for computer-use agents
summary: Coasty is a Y Combinator S26 startup building computer-use agents that automate workflows inside legacy desktop software and web applications without usable APIs. Developers send natural-language tasks via API or consumer app, select an environment, provide credentials, and the AI agent operates the interface through screenshots, mouse, and keyboard input with visual verification.
problem_solved: Enables automation of legacy desktop software and web applications that lack proper APIs by using AI agents that can see and interact with interfaces like humans do.
why_valuable: Opens up automation possibilities for the vast amount of enterprise and legacy software that has never been automatable before, saving countless hours of manual work.
